description:
Yeo Eui-Yeon, once a respected figure within his martial sect, vanished without a trace after betraying his order—murdering his own master and fellow disciples in cold blood. Do Hae-Gun, one of the sect's most promising young warriors, was raised like a son by Master Eui-Yeon. But after being suddenly abandoned as a child, Hae-Gun grew up with a deep scar—feeling discarded, betrayed, and driven by resentment. Years later, under orders to track down the fugitive Eui-Yeon, Hae-Gun sets out on a mission fueled by a twisted blend of loyalty and vengeance. But on his journey, he crosses paths with a mysterious man—someone who looks uncannily like his former master, yet behaves in completely different, disarming ways. Is this truly Eui-Yeon reborn? Or a stranger caught in the shadow of another man's sins?

In a world of blades and betrayal, what will Hae-Gun do when the line between past and present begins to blur?

(Source: Lezhin US)
